evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: The backlog lacks any music/audio upload or ingestion requirement, so the music content to be searched is never created within the set.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Requires music content to be present, but the backlog provides no music/audio creation capability.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Requires music content to be present, but the backlog provides no music/audio ingestion story.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video
evaluations.rationale: No story creates or ingests music or ringback tones, so this search cannot operate on a complete catalog.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: No story creates enriched music metadata or music-related image tags; only tagged video upload is present in ZO-006.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos
evaluations.rationale: Provides creation/ingestion for tagged video content, so downstream video stories have a source.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: No story generates video segments or thumbnail sequences; the views presuppose missing creation.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: No story computes or stores similar video items/segments, so similarity information is read without being created.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: No story computes or stores perceptual similarity, so this required derived data is absent.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Content creation already exists, and profile similarity is an analytical capability rather than a missing CRUD counterpart in this set.

evaluations.evidence: recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: No story ingests or detects news events or links them to geographic areas, so the recommendation input is missing.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained identification capability; video content creation exists via ZO-006.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained product identification over uploaded video content.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained logo identification over uploaded video content.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained brand identification over uploaded video content.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image
evaluations.rationale: Provides image ingestion and recommendation capability; no missing creation counterpart is exposed.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map
evaluations.rationale: No story creates georeferenced video data or coverage associations, so map-based discovery is incomplete.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: No story creates speech recognition transcripts or indexes them, so ASR search lacks a required creation step.

evaluations.evidence: edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: There is no story that creates video segmentation; editing without creation is an incomplete lifecycle.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments
evaluations.rationale: Annotation of segments requires segment creation, which is absent from the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Operates on existing uploaded video content; the analysis capability is self-contained.

evaluations.evidence: whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Pre-upload assessment is self-contained and does not manipulate a stored lifecycle object.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Content upload exists via ZO-006; filtering is self-contained.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low-level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Content creation exists; filtering does not expose a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Ingested content lifecycle is present; validation is self-contained.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high-level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Tagged video upload in ZO-006 supplies metadata/tags; filtering is self-contained.

evaluations.evidence: citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: The set lacks a requirement for creating citizen annotations or Talk comments, so the inputs are missing.

evaluations.evidence: annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: No story creates the annotations or comments consumed by this detection.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained classification; volunteer actors are not a missing created entity in this set.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images
evaluations.rationale: Input images are an existing external dataset; no missing creation is exposed in this backlog.

evaluations.evidence: detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained detection on an existing dataset.

evaluations.evidence: image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained analysis on existing image series.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained classification on existing Snapshot Serengeti images.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained classification on existing images.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained detection on existing images.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton
evaluations.rationale: The story itself creates segmentation/localization; no missing lifecycle is exposed.

evaluations.evidence: detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained detection on existing images.

evaluations.evidence: automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained analysis on existing images.

evaluations.evidence: automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained classification on existing images.

evaluations.evidence: automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained analysis on existing videos.

evaluations.evidence: detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained detection on existing videos.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained analysis on existing satellite images.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained assessment; no missing CRUD for a core object is exposed.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained preprocessing on existing images.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained detection on existing images.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: No story creates or ingests audio files, so audio preprocessing lacks its required source.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Whale-call audio is never uploaded or ingested; grouping reads audio absent from the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: No story creates or ingests audio files, so this detection lacks a source.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Decision logic; no missing lifecycle object is exposed.

evaluations.evidence: whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Decision logic; content modalities are not a missing CRUD object here.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Decision logic; no missing lifecycle object is exposed.

evaluations.evidence: whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Decision logic; no missing lifecycle object is exposed.

evaluations.evidence: which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: No story creates or manages educational content pieces, so selection reads from an absent collection.

evaluations.evidence: when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: No story creates volunteer comments; detection depends on missing comment creation.

evaluations.evidence: when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: No story creates or posts a Zoonibot comment; only the timing decision is specified.

evaluations.evidence: when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: No story creates or delivers an explanation; only the timing decision is specified.

evaluations.evidence: what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: No story stores or delivers the selected wording; message creation is missing.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: No story creates or imports subjects, so grouping them lacks the required source object.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained recommendation logic; actors and projects are not missing CRUD objects in this set.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: No story creates or imports articles; reading and reusing articles lacks required creation.
